# Detached desktop windows follow the selected theme and running tasks have a readable indicator

## Context

During the 23 November v14 manual test, Tobi clicked **Light** in torn-out Settings. The opener switched to light and the selected button reflected the new state, but the popup’s own controls and background stayed dark. His taskbar screenshot also showed an 18 CSS-pixel underline beneath the Mail icon and label.

## The Problem

`WindowTearOut` copies the owner’s effective theme when attaching a popup. It does not follow later theme changes. The task list styles every running task with the same short underline regardless of its button width.

## The Architectural Reality

The desktop controller already writes the theme once. `Neo.container.Viewport` synchronizes its theme with the document body. Workstation updates its own render targets, and the shared planning example observes its admitted source viewport’s theme. A Web Desktop popup belongs to a particular opener; independent desktop sessions can share the same App Worker. `src/desktop/TaskList.mjs` models running and minimized entries; those forms should remain distinguishable.

## The Fix

Apply the owning desktop’s current theme to each admitted popup at attachment and whenever that desktop changes theme. Preserve the existing task controls, accent, focus outline and minimized marker; make the running indicator span the icon and label.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Switching Light or Dark from detached Settings or from its desktop updates the opener and every attached popup of that desktop, including their document bodies. A separate desktop remains independent.
- [ ] A newly opened or reloaded popup picks up the current theme and continues to follow changes. Returning the popup preserves the app and task.
- [ ] A running task’s indicator scales to the task button at desktop and phone widths. A minimized task has a compact marker and keyboard focus remains visible. The Portal’s Web Desktop example preview shows the corrected running indicator.

Design authority: Tobi’s Web Desktop manual findings at 16:56 and 16:59 Berlin on 23 November. Part of #21198; the completed original gesture is #21603. Latest 20 open issues, open/closed theme, indicator and popup searches, and current team claims showed no existing delivery issue for these two appearance findings. Emmy is taking the repair.
